The '''Puloorn system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Spinward sector/Legends|Spinward sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Puloorn]].
